component.name: Image Compare
component.summary: Image comparison and visual diff tool

description.p: Image Compare is a desktop image comparison and visual diff tool for Linux and Windows. Compare two or more images side by side, stacked, or in a grid with synchronized zoom and pan, and generate perceptual heatmaps to highlight visual differences.
All images zoom and pan together. For different resolutions, relative sync keeps the same proportional region visible in each image.

Use it to choose the best-quality copy, inspect compression artifacts, scans, and exports, compare edited or upscaled versions, and catch subtle changes in color, sharpness, cropping, scaling, or encoding.

ul.li: Open images by drag and drop, file picker, command line, or file manager
Flip between images in stacked view or inspect several images in a grid
Synchronize all images, including proportionally across different resolutions
Generate and export perceptual heatmaps for two images
Switch between embedded color-profile rendering and raw rendering
Copy paths, open containing folders, reorder images, and close images
Load, zoom, and pan efficiently with Qt6 and libvips

screenshot.caption: Comparing two images side by side with a heatmap
